covers: Thursday 5 November 2026: JSE close and the full US session (closing prices)
headline: Tech rout on Wall Street: Nasdaq-100 fund −6.3% and chip fund −11.5%, with AMD −17%, Dell −15% and IREN −17%; JSE-listed shares rallied, Satrix 40 +4.5%
summary: On the JSE, the Satrix 40 fund rose 4.5% on Thursday, led by Naspers (+10.4%), Prosus (+8.0%), Harmony (+6.4%) and the big banks (LRC price data, 5 Nov). On Wall Street the S&P 500 fund (SPY) fell 4.4%, the Nasdaq-100 fund (QQQ) 6.3% and the chip fund (SMH) 11.5%, with AMD −17.3%, Dell −14.9%, Tesla −10.8% and Nvidia −9.3% (LRC price data, US close 5 Nov). The gold fund (GLD) rose 0.8% and the oil fund (USO) 1.8% while the copper fund fell 3.3%; this edition uses LRC's own closing prices only, and press figures (index points, the rand, the jobs report) will be added once verified.

items.title: US tech sell-off: Nasdaq-100 fund −6.3%, chip fund −11.5%
items.summary: At Thursday's close the Invesco QQQ (Nasdaq-100) fell 6.34% to $648.10 and is down 9.4% over a week; the VanEck semiconductor fund (SMH) fell 11.47% to $446.40, down 20.5% over a week. The S&P 500 fund (SPY) lost 4.41% and the Dow fund (DIA) 3.54%.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance closing prices), 5 Nov 2026

items.title: IREN (LRC Stock Scanner: STRONG SELL, target $9.17) −17% into its results
items.summary: IREN closed at $18.03, down 16.95% on Thursday, and was scheduled to report after the US close the same day. The scanner rating moved from HOLD in Thursday's brief to STRONG SELL on its own rules (broken chart, very weak score). Results details will be added once verified.
